liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **So Many Roads** (4 reviews): The reviewer says So Many Roads is the one reason this show earns any stars; Only part of So Many Roads is singled out as worth anything in an otherwise poor show [13][16][22][23]
- **Childhood's End** (1 review): Phil's playing is called the bright spot of the show, strong here and on Unbroken Chain and Box Of Rain [22]
- **Box Of Rain** (1 review): Box Of Rain is named among Phil's strong moments in the show [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **Childhood's End**: rare: 13 archived performances [24]
- **Fireworks**: rare: 8 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-07-09.aud.mahoney.86405.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 157 min; rated 2/5 by 18 [1]
- **gd95-07-09.sbd.7233.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 152 min; rated 3.06/5 by 361 [7]. Said about its sound: The reviewer rates the soundboard recording itself highly, at four stars; The reviewer says the recording quality is great [16][23]
- **gd1995-07-09.127735.nick.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 165 min; rated 1.4/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1995-07-09.aud.liberated-bootleg.larson.27977.flac16**: audience recording; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 2.38/5 by 8 [3]

## Around the show

- The reviewer saw Jerry's health decline as frightening and calls this the band's final, chillingly bad concert [15]
- The reviewer says Jerry's carpal tunnel syndrome and poor health badly hurt his playing; this is called the last show [23]
- The encore was Black Muddy River followed by Box Of Rain [2]
- The reviewer says the show shows how far the band had declined, and few post-1991 shows deserve five stars [13]
- The reviewer found this show even worse than the 1995 Shoreline run [15]
- The reviewer says Europe 72, May 73, May 77, Summer 82 and Summer 89 had many more five-star shows than 1995 [17]
- The reviewer says there are far better shows across the band's career, including other 1995 shows [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-07-09.aud.mahoney.86405.flac16**: taped by Mike Mahoney; transferred by Mike Mahoney; source: ? > Patch > Sony D6 > Master Cassette [1]
- **gd95-07-09.sbd.7233.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]
- **gd1995-07-09.127735.nick.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Nick; source: 3 source matrix from mix of audience source id 95445, soundboard source id 114369, and audience source id 86405 [2]
- **gd1995-07-09.aud.liberated-bootleg.larson.27977.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larsen; source: Bootleg "To The Sky: Jerry's Last Show" (probably AUD FOB) [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Soldier Field - July 9, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/july-9-1995) [25]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Original 1995 Final Tour Poster Framed *POSTER ONLY* | #1948030010](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-original-1995-final-1948030010) [26]
